attempts.summary: On node1, created a dedicated system account `inventorysvc` and a systemd service `inventory-worker` running /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as that user, enabled and started it, then performed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id and service health baseline, rebooted node1, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified the service returned to active/enabled state with the process owned by inventorysvc.
